Container.Name: Galleria
Container.Overview: Galleria is a modern, self-hosted photography portfolio platform built with React, TypeScript, and Express. Features include image optimization, album management, analytics, Google OAuth authentication, AI title generation (optional), MFA/Passkey support, and a beautiful responsive UI. Perfect for photographers who want full control over their portfolio without monthly fees.
Container.Requires: Open the WebUI and create a username and password. No email or domain is required. For a reverse proxy, forward your one domain to the WebUI port (container port 3000). Domain is optional; include https:// when setting it. Enable SSL in your reverse proxy. Keep your existing Data Directory mapping when updating. Existing split-domain setups remain supported: keep FRONTEND_DOMAIN, BACKEND_DOMAIN, and the API port mapping in your installed container configuration.

Config.Name: API Port (Optional, Legacy)
Config.Description: Optional backend port for existing split-domain reverse proxies. New installations only need the WebUI port.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Directory for photos, database, and configuration files

Config.Name: Domain (Optional)
Config.Description: Optional public URL, e.g. https://photos.example.com. Leave blank for access by IP or your reverse proxy hostname. Proxy all traffic to the WebUI port; a separate API domain is not needed.
